info.title: ZAI API
info.description: OpenAPI document for the ZAI app API (agents, sessions, messages, skills, memories and app settings).

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Manage agent definitions under the current app.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Create and manage conversation sessions for an agent.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Send messages, read history, and manage conversation turns.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Manage reusable skills and their revisions under the current app.

tags.name: Agent Skills
tags.description: Mount and manage reusable skills for an agent.

tags.name: Coding Runner
tags.description: ZAI runner workspace: SSH public keys, AGENTS.md, files and session git operations.

tags.name: Coding Workspaces
tags.description: Manage development workspaces under an runner agent.

tags.name: Coding Repositories
tags.description: Manage agent working repositories for the current external user.

tags.name: Memories
tags.description: Manage knowledge-base memory collections, content, embeddings, and processing jobs.

tags.name: App Settings
tags.description: Manage app-owned models/channels and read the ek-* signing secret (ak-* only).

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: Legacy conversation API: conversations, messages and streaming responses.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Extract text content from uploaded files.

tags.name: QA Pairs
tags.description: Manage QA pairs and run similarity lookups for smart responses.

token_scope.description: turn: sum of this Chat turn's model calls; provider: latest Coding provider snapshot, not necessarily a turn total

utilization.description: used_tokens / max_tokens; 0.5 means 50%. Not clamped. Null when unknown.

name.description: Collection name; must not be empty.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model available to this app; defaults to the app's default embedding model. An app default must be configured.

max_tokens_per_chunk.description: Chunk token budget, integer 1–8192; defaults to 1024. Accepts numbers and integer strings; empty or whitespace-only strings use the default. Null is rejected.

overlap_tokens.description: Overlap token count, integer 0–floor(max_tokens_per_chunk / 4); defaults to 0. Accepts numbers and integer strings; empty or whitespace-only strings use the default. Null is rejected.

MemoryCollectionCreateRequest.description: Only name is required. Omitted optional parameters use creation defaults, not an existing collection's settings. Chunk size is a token budget, not a strict final-length or model-compatibility guarantee.

embedding_model_available.description: Whether the effective embedding model (collection model, otherwise app default) is available to this app, with an app default configured. Checks embedding capability, app access, owner group, and enabled channels/abilities; does not probe upstream health.

status.description: Overall synchronization state; error takes precedence if any content has failed.

error.description: Failed content count. GET /memories/{id}/failures returns the paginated failed content IDs and redacted reasons.

content_sync.description: Embedding synchronization counts for this app and collection's non-deleted contents, including disabled contents; independent of model availability.

requeued.description: Non-deleted contents queued for embedding, including disabled contents; 0 for an empty collection. Acceptance is not completion.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model available to this app. If omitted, uses the current collection model, falling back to the app default. Empty strings and null are rejected.

max_tokens_per_chunk.description: Chunk token budget, integer 1–8192. Accepts numbers and integer strings; empty or whitespace-only strings keep the current value. Null is rejected.

overlap_tokens.description: Overlap token count, integer 0–floor(effective max_tokens_per_chunk / 4). Accepts numbers and integer strings; empty or whitespace-only strings keep the current value. Null is rejected. Changing chunk size also checks the retained overlap.

MemoryCollectionRebuildRequest.description: All parameters are optional. Omitted parameters keep the current configuration, including legacy chunk settings; send {} to rebuild without changing configuration.

total.description: Total failed, non-deleted contents, including disabled contents; not just the current page.

embedding_feedback.description: Latest applicable embedding job feedback. message is redacted and may be null when no current failure reason is available. Successful contents are never listed.

requeued.description: Distinct selected contents queued as new jobs. 0 means no new job was queued; acceptance is not completion.

skipped.description: Distinct selected contents already successful, pending/processing, or with an active job. Existing jobs are not modified.

content_ids.description: Content UUIDs in this collection; duplicates are ignored. Missing, deleted or other-collection/App IDs reject the entire request with 404.

all_failed.description: Retry all current non-deleted failed contents, including disabled contents, regardless of failure-list pagination.

MemoryCollectionRetryFailedRequest.description: Choose exactly one: non-empty content_ids (duplicates ignored), or all_failed: true for the current failed set. An empty request never means all.

model_id.description: Model identifier, also used as the upstream model name

model_type.description: Model capability type: 'chat' or 'embeddings'; null when unset

model_id.description: Model identifier. Must match the real upstream model name and only contain letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-'

model_type.description: Model capability type: 'chat' (default) or 'embeddings'. Use 'embeddings' for embedding models so the embedding capability config is applied

base_url.description: Upstream OpenAI-compatible base URL; public internet addresses only

api_key.description: Upstream API key; stored encrypted and never returned in plaintext

features.description: Model features, e.g. chat / reasoning / function-calling

reasoning_default_option_id.description: Deprecated compatibility input. The value is normalized into reasoning.default_option_id; null clears it and omission preserves it.

reasoning.description: Model-owned reasoning options and default. Null means supported without configurable levels; omission preserves the current value.

kind.description: Failure class; null on success. 'network' = unreachable or timed out, 'auth' = upstream rejected the key, 'model_not_found' = the upstream has no such model, 'upstream' = any other upstream error, including a probe that could not be sent at all.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip latency; 0 when the request was never sent

http_status.description: Upstream HTTP status; 0 for network-level failures and for probes that were never sent. Named http_status rather than status to stay distinct from the aggregate status field.

message.description: Upstream error text, or 'OK'. Safe to show; never contains the key.

requested.description: The identifier exactly as it appeared in the request, echoed so results can be matched by index.

model.description: Resolved model id, or null when the request carried an empty identifier.

capability.description: Capability the probe was resolved against; null when the model has no probeable capability. Determines the upstream path: text.chat via /chat/completions (or /responses when the model declares Native Responses API), text.embeddings via /embeddings.

access.description: Authorization state, checked before any billable request. 'ok' = the app may call this model; 'not_configured' = the request carried an empty model id; 'model_not_found' = no such model exists; 'unauthorized' = no enabled ability for the app owner's user group, no enabled channel, or the model is not available to this app. A non-'ok' value short-circuits: no upstream request is sent and charged_calls is not incremented.

probe.description: Upstream connectivity result, or null when not probed (short-circuited by a non-'ok' access). Deliberately carries no upstream URL: this is an app-facing API, and the probed channel may be a platform-owned one whose base_url the app cannot read through GET /channels. Diagnose from kind, http_status and message instead.

status.description: Aggregate verdict. 'unhealthy' = at least one model is unauthorized, missing or empty; 'degraded' = all are authorized but at least one probe failed or could not be sent; 'healthy' = every probe succeeded.

charged_calls.description: Number of billable upstream requests this call actually issued. 0 when every entry short-circuited.

results.description: One entry per requested id, in request order.

models.description: Model ids to test, 1 to 20 entries. Results come back in the same order. Each id must be a model this app may call; ids the app has no access to are reported as unauthorized rather than rejected, so a bulk check stays diagnosable.
Model ids bound to this channel

get.summary: Get the authenticated app user's token allowance
get.description: Available with ek-* or ak-* tokens. Identity comes from the authenticated token. Exhausted or expired allowances do not block this query. A new external user receives the current application default allowance on the first authenticated request, if a rule is configured. Later rule changes do not affect existing users. Deleting a limit never deletes historical usage or reapplies the default rule.

expiry_mode.description: Fixed expiration time or validity period counted from period_started_at.

validity_days.description: Validity in 24-hour days; null for fixed expiration.

available_tokens.description: Token limit; null means unlimited. Input and output tokens are added together.

used_tokens.description: Usage since the period start (first request for automatically assigned allowances, otherwise creation or last reset), grouped by model request start time.

remaining_tokens.description: Nonnegative remaining tokens; null means unlimited.

post.description: Create a new conversation session under the specified agent. The optional `skills` field is a session-level skill_id selection: omit it or set it to null to inherit all skills mounted on the agent; set it to [] to explicitly disable all skills for this session; set it to [skill_id...] to use exactly those active skills for this session. Session-selected skills may include any active skill under the app and do not need to be mounted on the agent.

thinking_option_id.description: Optional Chat thinking level; omitted or null preserves legacy behavior.

title.description: Optional user-facing session title. When omitted, Dathor creates a default title.

workspace_id.description: Runner agents only: bind the session to a development workspace by its uuid id (workspaces.id). The workspace must belong to this agent and be visible to the current user, otherwise the request is rejected. The binding is persisted as custom_data.workspace_id and all subsequent turns run inside that workspace. When omitted, the session falls back to the (agent, user) default workspace (lazily created). PI custom agents ignore this field (they do not participate in coding).

model.description: Optional model id for this session. It overrides the app default chat model and is persisted as the session model.

prompt.description: Optional session-level system prompt persisted as settings.prompt. It is appended after the agent system_prompt and developer_prompt when building the runtime system prompt. Set null to use no session-level prompt.

collections.description: Memory collection_id list enabled for retrieval in this session. Leave empty or omit it to disable memory retrieval.

content_filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied when searching memory contents, such as product, locale, or business category constraints.

min_similarity.description: Minimum similarity score required for a memory chunk to be used. Higher values make retrieval stricter.

limit.description: Maximum number of memory chunks returned for each retrieval step.

unmatch_message.description: Optional fallback message used when memory retrieval has no match. Use null to let the agent continue without a fallback message.

memories.description: Memory retrieval settings for this session.

reference_settings.description: Optional retrieval settings for this session. Use reference_settings.memories.collections to pass memory collection_id values.

custom_data.description: Optional session-scoped business metadata stored and returned with the session. Dathor only gives special meaning to documented keys, such as custom_data.repository_id for the default repository used by future turns.

skills.description: Optional session-level skill_id list. Omit or set null to inherit all skills mounted on the agent. Set [] to disable all skills for this session. Set [skill_id...] to use exactly those active skills, which may include any active skill under the app.

category.description: Optional session category used for list filtering and business grouping. Defaults to chat when omitted.

skill_ids.description: Session-level skill_id selection. Null means the session inherits all skills mounted on its agent.

get.summary: Stream session events as server-sent events
get.description: Replays current-conversation events after after_seq (or the Last-Event-ID header), then follows live events. Events from turns removed by Rewind are omitted by default; include_superseded=true selects the complete audit log. session.rewound remains visible so live clients can remove previously received turns. post.summary: Test whether given models actually work against their upstreams
post.description: Takes the model ids to test and reports two independent facts for each. `access` is authorization, resolved from the database and always checked first: a model that is not_configured / model_not_found / unauthorized is never probed, so no billable request is issued for it. `probe` is live upstream connectivity, null when the model was not probed. The upstream path is derived from the model's own capabilities: chat models via /chat/completions (or /responses when the model declares Native Responses API), embedding models via /embeddings. Requires an app admin token (ak-*). This endpoint is billable — each probed model issues exactly one real upstream request, and charged_calls reports how many were actually issued.

200.description: Per-model access and probe results, in request order
